snippet.title: Dr.Clone: A Mad Scientist Simulation - Steam Next Fest: February 2026 Demo
snippet.description:
Dr.Clone is a chaotic invention sandbox where you start out in your grandma’s old garage, armed with junk parts, sketchy tools, and dangerously high confidence (and the character designs are totally not "influenced" by a certain cartoon on Adult Swim!)
Craft bizarre gadgets, run unpredictable experiments, and try to keep the explosions to a minimum as strange clients teleport in with even stranger requests.

Turn curiosity into creations, accidents into progress, and your tiny garage into the birthplace of wonderfully questionable inventions.

Release Date: TBD [Early Access]
